day_shape: 95 items in an alt-2026 frame: CENTCOM enforcing a maritime blockade on Iran (90 ships redirected, 4 disabled, Marines boarding M/T Celestial Sea), Pakistan army chief Munir to Tehran mediating US-Iran talks, IDF strikes and Hezbollah drone attacks in south Lebanon wounding 10 Israeli soldiers, heavy Khamenei cycle marking second anniversary of Raisi.

threads.label: US maritime blockade enforcement on Iran
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US Marines from the 31st MEU boarded the Iranian-flagged tanker M/T Celestial Sea in the Gulf of Oman and posted imagery of B-1B and AH-1Z patrols enforcing the blockade. CENTCOM stated that as of 20 May, US forces had redirected 90 ships and disabled four; Iran's 'Hormuz Waterway Management' account told vessels to obtain permits to transit the strait.

threads.label: US-Iran talks and Pakistani mediation
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported US and Iran progressing toward a 'memorandum of understanding and principles' and a difficult Netanyahu-Trump call over the ceasefire track. IRIB and Defa Press said Pakistan army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir arrived in Tehran to mediate between Tehran and Washington, following two visits this week by Pakistan's interior minister Mohsen Naqvi.

threads.label: Iranian deterrence and defiance messaging
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian said forcing Iran into submission 'is an illusion' while IRGC and parliament's national security commission member Kowsari said missile and drone production continues; Qaani praised the Sumud flotilla. The Jerusalem Post cited an Iranian military source telling Russian state media Iran holds unused modern weapons, and Times of Israel reported an IRGC threat that war would 'spread far beyond the region' if US attacks resumed.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah drones
threads.summary: The Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported 10 IDF soldiers, including a brigade commander, were wounded in separate Hezbollah drone attacks in southern Lebanon, with one officer severely injured. The IDF Arabic spokesperson issued evacuation warnings for Habboush and Deir al-Zahrani and said a Hezbollah weapons production site was struck in a former clinic near a mosque in Tyre; Defa Press claimed Hezbollah has 10,000 FPV suicide drones ready.

threads.label: Gaza flotilla detentions and diplomatic fallout
threads.summary: Spain's foreign minister said 44 Spanish activists detained from the Global Sumud flotilla would be transferred to Spain via Turkey, as Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Itamar Ben-Gvir posted video taunting bound detainees. Defa Press quoted Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez saying he would push the EU to sanction Ben-Gvir, following his September ban from Spanish territory.

threads.label: Khamenei office marks Raisi anniversary
threads.summary: Khamenei's official Telegram channel published the full text, audio and video of the Supreme Leader's message for the second anniversary of Ebrahim Raisi's death, with extracts praising his 'responsibility, justice, active diplomacy' and a previously unreleased call to Raisi's widow. Defa Press and IRIB amplified reactions, including a weightlifter's tribute and announcements that Khamenei was named 'martyr of the year' for the Rahian-e Nour programme.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and information control
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Iran jailed a former national-team goalkeeper over a post criticising the slain supreme leader, and Iran International described how the regime's months-long internet blackout warps online discourse. The Jerusalem Post cited a Filterbaan study on isolation and depression under the blackout, while IRIB promoted a 'shekayatname.ir' campaign to file complaints against Iran International and Manoto.
